quote.text: Preserve a sense of proportion in your attitude to everything that pleases you, and make the most of them while they are at their best.
quote.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the moments of joy in parenting, like a child’s laughter or achievement, are transient treasures; cherish them fully while guiding your little ones with wisdom and temperance.
    • Maintain balance by celebrating successes and addressing challenges with equal measure—remember that overindulgence in any emotion can disrupt the natural flow of growth and learning.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, embrace the peak moments of success, but always temper them with a broader perspective; true leadership lies in maintaining steady resolve even when the tide of fortune shifts.
    • Understand that every achievement is fleeting and should be met with gratitude and moderation, thus inspiring your team to remain resilient and focused on the enduring mission.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, recognize that market trends and user enthusiasm are cyclical; harness the energy of a product’s peak without risking burnout or misplaced priorities.
    • Adopt a disciplined approach by celebrating milestones judiciously and preparing for inevitable changes, ensuring that both innovation and sustainability guide every decision.
